name: Michael Schachtner
headline: Managing Director & Partner at Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
location: New York, United States of America
summary:
With over a decade and a half at Boston Consulting Group (BCG), my journey has centered around steering financial services and insurance clients through the intricacies of digital and operating model transformation, with a keen focus on GenAI/Tech modernization and fostering new ways of working. At BCG, I'm leading our pioneering Build-Operate-Transfer model in North America, enabling our clients for sustained innovation.

As the Global Lead of BCG's Pride network, I've been elevating our DE&I efforts and representing BCG at the PGLE initiative of the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights and the World Economic Forum. Our efforts extend beyond the workplace, shaping thought leadership with our research and championing the intersection of diversity and technology.

positions.title: Managing Director & Partner
positions.description:
Michael serves clients in the Financial Services and Insurance industry on Digital Transformation topics, specifically Technology modernization, New Ways of Working and Tech Talent.  He is leading the Build-Operate-Transfer capabilities in North America.  

He is the Global Lead of BCG's Pride (LGBTQ+) network and represents BCG in the Steering Committee of PGLE, an initiative of the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights, and the World Economic Forum. 

Michael worked in BCG's Zurich and Amsterdam offices before moving to New York.  Prior to joining BCG, he worked for a Multi Family Office and was the Executive Editor of "Electronic Markets", a research journal, during his PhD studies.

company.name: Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
company.description:
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we work closely with clients to embrace a transformational approach aimed at benefiting all stakeholders—empowering organizations to grow, build sustainable competitive advantage, and drive positive societal impact.
 
Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives that question the status quo and spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting, technology and design, and corporate and digital ventures. 

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, fueled by the goal of helping our clients thrive and enabling them to make the world a better place.
